- This participant tends to thrive when faced with challenging and complex problems. - This participant tends to be deeply responsive to beauty and artistic expression. - This participant is often positive in outlook and inclined to expect things to work out. They are able to recover relatively quickly from setbacks and tend to focus on learning or opportunity rather than loss. Others may experience them as encouraging and forward-looking during periods of difficulty.

They generally maintain effort through to completion, while recognising when a task is genuinely finished rather than carrying it on needlessly. They are strongly committed to justice, transparency, and equal treatment, even when doing so is inconvenient or costly. They are generally attentive to quality and detail while managing effort effectively across tasks. They typically produce reliable work and follow through on commitments at a steady level.
- This participant is often attentive to social norms and considerate in how they communicate. They are likely to show courtesy and deference where appropriate, especially in formal or hierarchical settings. Others may experience them as polite, thoughtful, and respectful in interactions.
- This participant shows a balanced level of emotional expressiveness. They are comfortable sharing positive emotions while also maintaining appropriate boundaries. They can adapt their level of expressiveness to suit different people and situations.
